questions.key_step: Rotation in the plane of a and j: b along a×(a×j), sign choice, projection.
questions.justification: Triple-product expansion, sign choice from the rotation direction and a projection: chain of four steps, but each is standard. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Cosine rule for projection.
questions.justification: One familiar move: projection = c cos A with the cosine rule. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Spot a+b+c=0 with a=x-11 etc.
questions.justification: Recognising 11+19+12=42 then the a³+b³+c³=3abc identity: one idea, short algebra. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Bisector of two vectors: sign ambiguity decides the option.
questions.justification: Coplanarity plus both bisector cases; the first natural case matches no option, so the student must try the other sign. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Sylvester: PA+PB+PC=PQ with circumcentre as origin.
questions.justification: One well-known result (Euler line, OG:GH=1:2) applied once. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: BAC-CAB then Lagrange identity.
questions.justification: Two standard identities chained; no insight beyond reading off a.c and a.b. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: B from a.n=0, then foot of perpendicular and distance.
questions.justification: Routine four-step chain: intersecting line, parallel to plane, foot, distance. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Dot the given equation with v and w.
questions.justification: Orthogonality of a cross product removes it; two short dot products. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Section formula + plane + distance gives quadratic.
questions.justification: Routine chain with a sign condition to choose the root. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Length invariant under rotation of axes.
questions.justification: One familiar move: rotation preserves length, then a quadratic. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Equal products give 1/a+1/b+1/c proportional to cosines summing to zero.
questions.justification: The hidden sum cosθ+cos(θ+2π/3)+cos(θ+4π/3)=0 and the reciprocal trick are not the usual pattern; also the K≠0 check. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: (b-a).(a×b)=0 collapses the triple product to (|a|²-|b|²)(a×b).
questions.justification: Nested triple product needing simplification before computing; the shortcut is not obvious and direct expansion is long. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: P1+λP2 with perpendicularity of normals.
questions.justification: Standard family-of-planes chain: cross product normal, perpendicular normals, read coefficients. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: CA is the normal; plane through origin gives a; foot D.
questions.justification: Routine chain: normal, a, foot of perpendicular, distance. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Mid-points of diagonals via position vectors.
questions.justification: One familiar move: write the vectors with position vectors. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Intersection of line and plane, distance, quadratic with roots q,2q.
questions.justification: Routine chain of three standard formulas. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: BAC-CAB with a.c=12α.
questions.justification: Triple-product expansion with a small substitution. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Direction cosines give the normal.
questions.justification: One familiar move: direction cosines to normal, plane through a point. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Four-point coplanarity determinant.
questions.justification: Standard determinant with a parameter; routine arithmetic. JEE Main-style bank question.

questions.key_step: Expand [b-a c-a d-a]=0 and match by cyclic permutation.
questions.justification: Expansion of a triple product with careful sign/cyclic matching against four similar options. JEE Main-style bank question.
